class.name: HTMLMutationObserver
class.brief_description: Observes DOM changes in one or more HTML layouts.
class.description: Call [method observe] for each target. Use [signal mutations_delivered] for deferred batches or [method take_records] for synchronous polling. Callback edits enter a later delivery. Clearing a layout drops its registered observations and undelivered records.

method.name: observe
method.description: Observes the target using the boolean options child_list, attributes, character_data, subtree, attribute_old_value, and character_data_old_value. The attribute_filter option accepts an array of attribute names. At least one mutation category must be enabled.

method.name: disconnect
method.description: Removes all registrations and discards pending records.

method.name: take_records
method.description: Returns the queued record dictionaries in order and drains the queue.

signal.name: mutations_delivered
signal.description: Emitted with a snapshot of the layout's pending records. Each record has the keys type, target, added_nodes, removed_nodes, previous_sibling, next_sibling, attribute_name, and old_value.
